name: Brachyuranochampsa
sum: Middle Eocene crocodyloid from Wyoming, consistently recovered just outside crown Crocodylidae.
holotype: Type material of B. eversolei, Middle Eocene of Wyoming.
material: The only robust occurrence is B. eversolei; B. zangerli has been synonymized with "Crocodylus" affinis.
biology: The sources say nothing about its biology.
author: Zangerl 1944
